name: Dragon CRS-6
about: Dragon CRS-6 (2015-021A), a crewed vehicle (Dragon), launched 2015 Apr 14. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (GRP).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2015 Apr 16), held fixed
docked to A06499; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
